items.headline: Winless no more — the 0-4 Bucs shock the Cowboys in Dallas, 24-16
items.body: Tampa Bay walked into AT&T Stadium winless and walked out with its first victory of the year. Backup quarterback Jalon Daniels, making just his second start for the injured Baker Mayfield, played a clean, turnover-free game, while running back Bucky Irving did the damage — 165 rushing yards and two touchdowns, including a 72-yard sprint. Dak Prescott threw for 316 yards but was picked off twice, the second interception slamming the door late.
items.say: Did you catch Thursday night? The winless Bucs went into Dallas and shocked the Cowboys — their backup quarterback barely blinked and their running back went for 165 yards and two scores. This NFL season's been wild. You riding with anybody this year?

items.headline: Down to the final four — the pennant round starts this weekend
items.body: October's heavyweight bout is here. In the National League, the top-seeded Brewers — who won more games than anybody this year — host the star-studded Dodgers in the NLCS, with Game 1 on Sunday. In the American League, the small-payroll Rays (who swept the Yankees out) are through to the ALCS and await the winner of the White Sox–Guardians slugfest. Four teams left, two World Series tickets up for grabs.
items.say: Baseball's down to the final four this weekend — the pennant series start Sunday. Big-money Dodgers against the little-market Brewers in the National League is a great contrast. You got a team still alive, or just here for October?

items.headline: Hockey's back — and the champs got spoiled on their own banner night
items.body: The new NHL season dropped the puck, and the defending-champion Hurricanes had their big night crashed. On banner night in Raleigh, the Panthers' Gustav Forsling ripped a one-timer from the point with 4.3 seconds left in overtime to steal a 1-0 win — a rematch of the two most recent Stanley Cup winners. Goalie Jacob Markstrom slammed the door with a 15-save shutout.
items.say: Hockey's back — and on opening night the defending champs raised their banner and then lost in overtime with like four seconds left. Brutal and kind of amazing. You follow any hockey, or wait for the playoffs?

items.headline: The CS2 arena playoffs begin today in Katowice's legendary Spodek
items.body: The business end of ESL Pro League Season 24 is here. After a week of Swiss-stage scrapping, the eight best teams — Vitality, MOUZ, Falcons, Team Spirit and more — move into a single-elimination bracket inside Katowice's famous Spodek arena, one of the loudest buildings in all of esports. Best-of-three matches today and tomorrow build to Sunday's best-of-five grand final and a share of the $1M prize pool.
items.say: The big Counter-Strike playoffs start today in that huge Polish arena — eight teams left, single elimination, million-dollar prize, final on Sunday. You ever watch any esports, or is it a total mystery to you?

items.headline: Georgia at Alabama — the SEC's heavyweight bout is Saturday night
items.body: The biggest game on Saturday's board is a classic: unbeaten Georgia rolls into Tuscaloosa to face powerhouse Alabama under the lights (7:30 p.m. ET). These two have owned college football for a decade, and there's fresh needle — Alabama snapped Georgia's long home winning streak last year before the Dawgs got their revenge in the SEC Championship. Playoff stakes, a deafening crowd, the whole deal.
items.say: Big one Saturday night — Georgia at Alabama, basically the two kings of college football. That stadium gets deafening. You follow any college ball on Saturdays, or just the pros?

items.headline: ACL weekend two takes over Austin — Charli xcx, Lorde, Twenty One Pilots
items.body: The second weekend of the Austin City Limits Festival rolls into Zilker Park (Friday through Sunday), and the headliner slate is stacked. Charli xcx and Kings of Leon close out Friday, Lorde and RÜFÜS DU SOL headline Saturday, and The xx and Twenty One Pilots cap Sunday — with Turnstile, Bleachers and a long list more all over the undercard. One of those great music-all-day, people-watching fall weekends.
items.say: The big Austin City Limits festival is on this weekend — Charli xcx, Lorde, Twenty One Pilots, the whole lineup. Looks like a blast. You ever do the festival thing, or is that firmly behind you now?

items.headline: Remi Wolf's 'Mud' is out today — funky, fuzzy and a lot of fun
items.body: New Music Friday has a real standout: Remi Wolf, the Bay Area pop weirdo with the huge voice, drops her third album 'Mud' today. The lead single 'Twiggy' — complete with a gloriously goofy mud-wrestling video — set the tone: big hooks, horns, and that loose, funky energy she's known for. Perfect windows-down, turn-it-up stuff for the drive.
items.say: There's a fun new album out today from Remi Wolf called 'Mud' — big, funky, kind of goofy pop. Great mood music. You keep up with new music, or stick with what you know?

items.headline: Shane Gillis hosts SNL tonight — with Rosalía as the musical guest
items.body: Saturday Night Live rolls on this weekend (Sat, Oct 10) with comedian Shane Gillis pulling hosting duty for the third time — he's usually good for a sketch or two that everyone's quoting by Monday. Spanish superstar Rosalía is the musical guest, back for her second SNL turn behind her acclaimed album 'LUX.' Then the show takes a couple weeks off before a Halloween-night return.
items.say: Shane Gillis is hosting SNL this weekend with Rosalía as the musical guest — his episodes usually have a sketch everyone's sharing the next day. You still watch SNL, or just catch the clips in the morning?
